title: Fill in the Blanks
description: Complete each sentence with the correct word from the box.

questions.text: Preserving ancestral storytelling helps minority communities maintain their unique cultural __________ in modern times.
The international student suffered from mild __________ during his initial weeks abroad because daily social customs felt so unfamiliar.
Even when foreign travelers face a steep __________, friendly smiles and helpful translation apps can establish immediate mutual understanding.
The stage actor spent several days hand-sewing an ornate ethnic __________ decorated with silver coins and colorful silk embroidery.
Clam chowder served in a toasted sourdough bowl is a world-famous coastal __________ that tourists always order when visiting the harbor.
Fresh lemongrass is an indispensable __________ that imparts a vibrant citrus flavor to Southeast Asian soups and marinades.
Upcycling second-hand clothing has become a fashionable eco-friendly __________ among high school students who care about sustainability.
The sudden surge in the __________ of Korean street snacks has prompted many night markets to open tteokbokki stalls.
Joining the youth debate society as an __________ enabled Nam to build valuable public speaking skills and expand his worldview.
Guests at the cultural fair clapped rhythmically while watching performers leap skillfully over moving poles during a lively __________ demonstration.
